# MCP contract fixtures

These fixtures are contract evidence, not recordings from a live host or Chrome. The `manifests/`, `schemas/tools.v1.json`, `tool_catalog.json`, and HTTP transcript/workflow files preserve the removed direct-CDP MCP interface as historical Phase 2 records; they are not current tool inventories or supported transports.

Current MCP exposes host-backed logical tools over stdio only. Its live integration and distribution status is tracked in [`docs/mcp-compatibility.md`](../../../docs/mcp-compatibility.md) and the Phase 8 execution plan. The archived fixture data does not establish current support or release readiness.
